sources.title: moon_small.glb
sources.text: nasa-svs-14959-moon-small-glb-2026 visual_model_3d https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a010000/a014900/a014959/moon_small.glb NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center; NASA SVS 14959 (producer Dan Gallagher); made with LRO imagery; color source CGI Moon Kit (SVS 4720) visualization_only Color map wrapped on a sphere, no topography. Not a substitute for the LOLA polar DEM; shows no illumination or visibility. Embedded texture is a 4096x4096 PNG (12,171,911 bytes). Chosen over Moon_NASA_LRO_15k_Grid_Small.glb (SHA-256 f688e87b57e182d29da6040edfcc8e50360c90639b86f12370381cfde31b17ef, 7,233,908 bytes) because the grid model bakes lat/lon lines into the texture and the page itself calls its pinched poles an artifact (measured in BR41). glTF 2.0 binary (GLB), single textured sphere mesh, color map only, no topography

sources.title: AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608.TIF
sources.text: pgda-69-avgvisib-85s-60m polar_illumination_map https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/data/MoonIllumination/AVGVISIB_85S_060M_201608.TIF Erwan Mazarico (page author); LOLA team; PDS Geosciences Node candidate_independent_benchmark_for_horizon_gates_G4_G5; averages over ~18.6 yr nutation cycle at hourly steps, NOT a time series for a 2026-12 window; not ingested Same page also offers Earth visibility (AVGVISIB_*_EARTH), permanent shadow (LPSR_85S_060M_201608.TIF, 656183 bytes, sha256 e9544c081dd4e36f079e92bc3a376d0913857a61a4a53c209175c081762de43c) and sky visibility (65 deg only). Earth counted visible if any part of its disc is unobscured (slightly optimistic for DSN links, per page). GeoTIFF (converted from PDS IMG int16; IMG and JP2 also offered; COG link on page returned an HTML error page via curl on 2026-11-14)
